title: Australian Antarctic Program -- Expeditioner Roles (2027-28 Season)
description: Paid seasonal and year-round positions supporting Australia's three continental Antarctic research stations (Casey, Davis, and Mawson), run by the Australian Antarctic Division. Roles span trades (electricians, carpenters, mechanics, diesel/power technicians), hospitality (chefs), science and meteorology, aviation, IT, and medical staff, with contracts from four months up to 12+ months (some requiring an Antarctic winter). Salaries vary widely by role -- as one example, the Voyage Leader position starts at roughly AUD 116,000/year based in Australia, rising to about AUD 187,000/year while deployed south, plus a substantial employer superannuation contribution. The Division covers airfares to and from Hobart, Tasmania (the program's mainland gateway and staging point), accommodation in Hobart before deployment, and transport of personal cargo to the station and back. Selection is thorough -- written application, medical screening, technical interview, an assessment centre, and medical/psychological clearance -- and can take up to 9 months. Under the Public Service Act 1999, applicants are generally required to be Australian citizens, with only rare, position-specific exceptions. Applications for the 2027-28 season open 1 October 2026 and close 31 October 2026.
visaNote: Positions are generally restricted to Australian citizens under the Public Service Act 1999; no separate work visa is needed for eligible citizens.
